title: Hyperbolicity cones without semidefinite lifts

result.label: Hyperbolicity cones without semidefinite lifts
result.statement: Disproves the Projected Lax conjecture: some hyperbolicity cones are not spectrahedral shadows. The examples admit no exact finite affine semidefinite lift, regardless of the number of auxiliary variables or the real coefficients used. This also disproves the generalized Lax conjecture that every hyperbolicity cone is spectrahedral.
